purpose: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one.
use_when: Designing a new landing page, website, or app UI with distinctive visual identity
Reshaping existing UI: aesthetic direction, typography, palette, layout choices
Reviewing UI that looks templated or generic and needs opinionated design direction
do_not_use_when: Interviewing or sharpening a plan before building (use grill-with-docs)
Optimizing React render or bundle performance of existing code (use react-best-practices)
Backend, database, auth, or GPU work
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Doing visual/UI design -> this. Interviewing the user to sharpen a plan -> grill-with-docs. Fixing performance of existing React code -> react-best-practices.
